title: Little Impact of ChatGPT on High School Test Scores
abstract: arXiv:2605.08812v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In educational settings, AI can be used as a learning aid, but can also be used to avoid schoolwork, passing classes while learning little. Most existing evidence on AI's educational impact comes from trials of supervised instructor-encouraged AI usage, rather than on unsupervised usage which is of the most concern. This paper uses the dropoff in ChatGPT activity during non-school summer months to identify areas with heavy educational AI use, and then estimates the effect of that usage on aggregate United States high school test scores. Areas with higher educational AI use were not significantly different from other areas, with an insignificant effect estimated to be close to zero, and in the preferred specification bounded below roughly 0.04 standard deviations of test score performance in absolute terms.

translated_title: ChatGPT对高中考试成绩的影响甚微
translated_abstract: 在教育环境中，人工智能既可以作为学习辅助工具，也可能被用来逃避学业，在学到很少知识的情况下通过课程。现有关于人工智能教育影响的大多数证据来自有监督的、教师鼓励使用人工智能的试验，而非最受关注的无监督使用情形。本文利用暑假非上学期间ChatGPT活动量的下降来识别教育类人工智能使用密集的地区，进而估计这种使用对美国高中总体考试成绩的影响。结果显示，教育类人工智能使用率较高的地区与其他地区没有显著差异，估计出的影响接近于零且不显著，在首选模型设定下，其绝对值下界约为考试成绩的0.04个标准差。
tldr: 本文创新性地利用暑假期间ChatGPT活动量的下降来识别教育类AI使用密集的地区，发现这种无监督的AI使用对美国高中总体考试成绩几乎没有显著影响。
en_tdlr: Using the summer dropoff in ChatGPT activity to identify areas with heavy educational AI use, this paper finds that unsupervised AI usage has little to no significant impact on aggregate US high school test scores.
